Steps[]

  1. Investigate the surroundings
  2. Defeat the enemies
  3. Talk to the mysterious man
  4. Find Taoqi
  5. Fend off the TD Outbreak
  6. Go help the soldiers
  7. Rescue the soldier
  8. Defeat the Tacet Discords in the base
  9. Defeat the incoming Tacet Discords
  10. Go to the Tacet Field in Desorock Highland
  11. Defeat the Tacet Discords
  12. Go to the Tacet Field in Desorock Highland
  13. Check on the injured soldier
  14. Defeat the Thundering Mephis
  15. Go to the military base
  16. Go to the command center
  17. Find the soldier in question
  18. Take the elevator to reach the Disruptor
  19. Defeat the TDs around the Disruptor
  20. Talk to the surviving soldier
  21. Protect the Disruptor from the incoming TDs
  22. Enter the Norfall Valley
  23. Go deeper into the Norfall Valley
  24. Defeat the enemies
  25. Press on
  26. Slide down the steep slope
  27. Leap over the cliff
  28. Defeat the enemies
  29. Enter the Hovering Ruins
  30. Find a way in
  31. Explore the depths of the Hovering Ruins
  32. Press on
  33. Defeat the enemies
  34. Head to the upper levels
  35. Reach the highest place in the Hovering Ruins
    1. Follow the road
    2. Defeat the enemy
    3. Look for a movable platform
    4. Move to the safe zone
    5. Go to the top of the building
    6. Go to the next Hovering building
    7. Try to "pull" walls to defeat enemies
    8. Go through the obstacles
    9. Try to pull walls to defeat enemies
    10. Continue forward
    11. Defeat the Inpermanence Heren
    12. Go to the next Hovering building
    13. Try to utilize the wind field to get to the upper floors of the building
    14. Remove the last obstacle by pulling it
    15. Use the wind field to get to the top of the Hovering Ruins
  36. Enter "Warblade from Above"
  37. Defeat the Crownless
  38. Defeat the Enemy
  39. Defeat the Monster in front of you
  40. Leave "Warblade from Above"

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.
(Talk to the Midnight Ranger on guard)
Midnight Ranger on Guard: General, we're all clear in the west!
Jiyan: Good. Have you had more hallucinations after the antidote?
Midnight Ranger on Guard: No sign of those Retroact Rain Phantoms they warned us about, but...
Midnight Ranger on Guard: I just heard some weird noises from the north.
Jiyan: Stay here and hold your post. I'll go check it out.
Midnight Ranger on Guard: Understood!
(Talk to the Steadfast Midnight Ranger)
Steadfast Midnight Ranger: General.
Jiyan: Greetings. How are you feeling after the antidote?
Steadfast Midnight Ranger: I feel much better, but the Phantoms are still coming back from time to time.
Steadfast Midnight Ranger: Three years... It's been three years already.
Steadfast Midnight Ranger: I was on the vanguard team during that battle.
Steadfast Midnight Ranger: Memories of my teammates lost their minds fighting those Phantoms haunts me to this day...
Steadfast Midnight Ranger: Those Phantoms... Illusions of both soldiers and those monsters... They were not real, but somehow they could injure and kill us.
Steadfast Midnight Ranger: We had to strike them down to survive.
Steadfast Midnight Ranger: But then... Our dead comrades, were coming back to life, ready to stab us behind our backs... It was chaos. We were terrified, couldn't tell friend from foe...
Jiyan: The Retroact Rain contains Remnant energy that can recreate past events and project them as Phantoms.
Jiyan: Those Phantoms can transform into familiar people or objects by resonating with living people in the rain, through their frequencies.
Jiyan: During that battle, the rain's effect was further enhanced by the Threnodian's power.
Jiyan: That was why the Phantoms gained physical forms, and why the rain could recreate very recent events, like bringing back soldiers dead minutes ago.
Jiyan: Unaware of the mechanism behind it, we tried to eliminate all the Phantoms, and it only worsened the situation.
Jiyan: Now we know the Phantoms are merely replicas of past events.
Jiyan: While not a perfect solution, the antidote for Retroact Rain can lessen its effects and help us differentiate between reality and hallucinations.
Jiyan: Keep your chin high. Our fallen comrades wouldn't want to see us down trodden like this.
Steadfast Midnight Ranger: Yes, sir. I will pull myself together!
Steadfast Midnight Ranger: General... You were there during the Battle Beneath the Crescent, too. Please be careful of the Phantoms in our camp.
(Watch the two "people" on the right near the computer)
Paranoid Midnight Ranger: Can we really trust that medic?
Thoughtful Midnight Ranger: I do think we should be careful... Something's wrong with this rain.
Paranoid Midnight Ranger: Hey! You see? The raindrops... they're falling up! It's the Retroact Rain!
Jiyan: That day... As the rain fell, we watched in uncertainty, unsure whether it was a sign of hope or disaster.
Jiyan: The Retroact Rain should have been a harmless Waveworn Phenomenon.
Jiyan: However... The Threnodian's influence enhanced its effect, turning that battle into a brutal slaughter.
Jiyan: Our city cannot endure another tragedy like that...
(Watch the two "people" on the left near the canopy)
Veteran Midnight Ranger: Let's join the Riverside Games after we beat that monster.
Young Midnight Ranger: The Riverside Games...?
Veteran Midnight Ranger: You won first place in the last armed race, remember? Don't back out now... I already counted you in!
Jiyan: We haven't held the Riverside Games in years. This should be another illusion from the past.
Jiyan: If everything goes well, perhaps we can hold it again this year...
(Watch the two "people" on the left near the computer)
Excited Midnight Ranger: This guy packs a serious punch. It's already so powerful in my hands when I'm just an ordinary person. Now, if I was a Resonator...
Vigilant Midnight Ranger: Careful. Tacetite weapons are not so safe to operate.
Excited Midnight Ranger: Rest assured. I'll take out those monsters before it blows up in my face!
Jiyan: The Ministry of Development once designed a weapon for non-Resonator units to combat Tacet Discords.
Jiyan: As non-Resonators lacked the necessary Fortespecial power to control the weapon, and prolonged exposure to Tacetite energy posed health risks, designers limited its output for safety reasons.
Jiyan: That's why the weapons couldn't operate at full power.
Jiyan: After taking over as General, I revamped the Midnight Ranger's recruitment tactics. Our primary combat units now consist of Resonators, with a significant decreased in non-Resonator members who have been reassigned to support roles.
Jiyan: I still remember the admirable courage in those ordinary people's eyes, as they volunteered to join the military... but I cannot let more unnecessary causalities happen.
(Watch the three "people" near the hologram diagram)
Solemn Midnight Rover: The plan is simple. We will use the cliffs as a boundary to divide the battlefield into two.
Solemn Midnight Rover: Our ranged units will secure the high ground while our ground forces charge through the narrow valley.
Solemn Midnight Rover: Meanwhile, we will deploy Resonators to the Suspended Ruins, where most of the Tacet Discords are located.
Solemn Midnight Rover: Squads two and three will flank while General Geshu leads Squad one to break their front line.
Solemn Midnight Rover: Our goal is to shift from defense to offense and disrupt their strategies. Everything is at stake here.
Solemn Midnight Rover: In a word, it's victory or death.
Jiyan: Our strategic plan was crafted 3 years ago, taking into account the terrain in Norfall Barrens. Its value remains crucial today.
Jiyan: But now, our enemies are even stronger than before.
Jiyan: There could be unknown risk factors... We must devise a new plan for the current situation.
(Watch the saber on the table on the far left)
Giant Saber with Strange Shape: A massive greatsword with a heavy weight. Its texture reveals its power, clearly not meant for the average person.
Giant Saber with Strange Shape: Black chains wrap around the blade and hilt, with swirling patterns resembling rippling waves. Dark flames seems to pulse with life, ready to erupt at any moment.
Giant Saber with Strange Shape: Droplets of water can be seen on it. Are these the tears of this mighty weapon?
Jiyan: Why am I seeing this here... Is it another illusion caused by the Retroact Rain?
Soldier: General!
Soldier: We've got all equipment repaired, Tacetite weapons adjusted and given to Resonators. Non-Resonators are also equipped and prepared for action.
Soldier: But... the rain's getting heavier. Should we take shelter for the time being?
Soldier: One of our combat medics claims it's no ordinary downpour, and he strongly advises holding off any moves until it clears.
Soldier: Though young, his sharp intuition has been proven in previous battles. You've seen it firsthand.
Soldier: However... I do agree this will be our last chance at organizing another attack.
...The medic you mentioned. What is his name?
Soldier: Sir, his name is...
Soldier: Ji...yan...
Soldier: General, help... Please... help me...
???: What do you make of this, Jiyan?
???: Maybe you are right.
???: The rain just happened out of nowhere. It's indeed unusual. But...
???: This is our only chance.
???: The enemy we've been yearning to destroy is finally right before us.
???: And now you're asking me to sit back and do nothing because of some Phantoms?
(Stay silent.)
???: Silence... is this your response? Or is it fear holding your tongue?
???: Ah... I see. You're no different. We fear, we bleed, we suffer, and in the end, we'll all die on the battlefield.
???: But what about your brethren, friends, and comrades? As you witness them viciously slain before your eyes, one by one...
???: Will you still remain silent when their souls demand an answer?
???: There is no other choice. We must trample the pile of corpses at our feet and push on. Keep barking orders, keep fighting until every last one of those monsters is gone.
???: The Retroact Rain merely creates illusions of past events. My soldiers will not succumb to those hallucinations. I will not allow it.
???: We'll crush anything in our path, no questions asked.
???: And I will pave the way for us all with my Forte.
???: If tens, hundreds, thousands more of my men will die... So be it. We will win this battle, by any means necessary.
???: Jiyan, I have a question for you... What would you have done on that day, if you were in my postion?
???: Whatever you say... I'll never answer those brave souls with such silence and cowardice.
???: Prove yourself to me, Jiyan.
???: Caught you off guard, didn't they? Just like what happened on that rainy night...
???: Yes... Go on, Keep fighting.
???: Fight... Until the last of them is wiped out.
Jiyan: General Geshu Lin... We fight to protect what we cherish.
Jiyan: And we cherish our comrades, not out of cowardice of fear, but out of trust. The trust in their lives' worth.
Jiyan: I cannot assure you I am always making the right choice, General.
Jiyan: But we should never build our victory on top of endless sacrifices...
Geshu Lin: Hah, is that so?
Geshu Lin: As I see it, we are cut from the same cloth, you and I.
Jiyan: Perhaps we are indeed, General. I share at least one thing with you. I, too, will draw my blade to fight for what I believe in... and I'll stop at nothing to see it through.
Soldier: General!
Jiyan: ...
Soldier: General... You look pale.
Jiyan: I am fine. Please go on.
Soldier: We just detected an intense frequency from that Tacet Field ahead.
Soldier: That moon... It's gradually turning full now, as you predicted.
Soldier: The sky... It looks just like how it was during the Battle Beneath the Crescent...
Jiyan: It's time.
Soldier: Sir, the Midnight Rangers are ready. We await your orders.
Jiyan: Attention all troops! Take position and get ready to engage!
Soldier: Yes, sir!
Jiyan: "When the moon turns full, a roving traveler shall return"... The prophecy is being fulfilled.
Jiyan: Here they are.
Jiyan: They're not coming at us... Are they trying to protect something... Or are they waiting for commands?
Jiyan: With an TD Outbreak of this magnitude and organization, someone must be orchestrating it. Could it be...
(Cutscene plays) (Cutscene ends)
Is it just me?
The moon, it's changing...
Yangyang: It looks almost full now.
Yangyang: And the Retroact Rain falling... Rover, maybe this is "the right time" Madam Magistrate was talking about?
Jinhsi (Contacting): ...Citizens of Jinzhou, please remain calm and evacuate in an orderly manner as we practiced during previous drills...
Jinhsi?
Chixia: It's a pre-recorded broadcast message. Our Magistrate saw this coming, and she had General Jiyan devise an emergency plan a long time ago.
Chixia: This wave of TD attacks should be over now.
Chixia: We knew this was coming and we were ready, but oh boy, the amount of TDs is insane.
Chixia: Thanks for coming in time, Rover. It would've taken us much longer to handle this.
Chixia: Oh, Director Taoqi is here too. For a better run down of the situation, you can find her near the city gate!
(If player talks to Yangyang before Taoqi)
Weary Patroller: I must send these supplies to our men...
Chixia: You're injured... Please go get yourself patched up first!
Yangyang: Chixia is right. Please leave it to us. We'll help deliver these supplies.
Weary Patroller: Huff... Okay... Thank you!
Chixia: Rover, Yangyang and I need to get these stuff delivered.
Chixia: Director Taoqi should be at the northern pass. We'll go meet you there as soon as we're done!
(If player talks to Little Boy before Taoqi)
Little Boy: Come on! Take down those bad guys!
Worried Patroller: It's too dangerous here. Please go back.
(If player talks to Eldery Person before Taoqi)
Elder: Young man, we've gathered something for the troops. Please take care.
Caring Patroller: Thanks, sir! I'll share them with my teammates. It's dangerous, please head back as soon as possible.
(If player talks to Lingyang before Taoqi)
Little Boy: *sob* I-I'm scared...
Lingyang: Shhh, everyone will be alright. Look, the Patrollers and guards are all here to help. Those bad monsters won't stand a chance!
Lingyang: But it's getting dangerous outside. We'll get you home real quick, okay?
Lingyang: Hi, Rover! I'm Lingyang from the Liondance Troupe. Thank you so much for your help! If you don't mind, here's some food. Please have some!
Lingyang: Ugh, those damn Tacet Discords. They just keep showing up out of nowhere...
Lingyang: But worry not, the Liondance Troupe is here! We'll teach them a lesson!
Lingyang: No one can beat us when it comes to morale!
(If player talks to Verina before Taoqi)
Verina: This lesion looks bad... Please stay still. I'll heal you with my Forte.
Injured Midnight Ranger: My wounds are closing up... Thank you, Miss Verina!
Verina: It's nothing. Glad I could help!
Verina: Rover, are you alright? Let me heal you if you got injured.
Verina: Jinzhou is such a beautiful place. The plants here are incredibly resilient. It's heartbreaking to imagine all of them getting wiped out from this war...
Verina: I still have some herbs with me, Rover. They can help your wounds heal. I hope it helps.
(If player talks to Yuanwu before Taoqi)
Sincere Patroller: ...And that's all we've gathered so far...
Yuanwu: If the wounded can't be transferred to hospitals in time, take them to my teahouse and boxing gym. We can set up temporary medical points there.
Sincere Patroller: Thank you, Mr. Yuanwu!
Yuanwu: As a citizen, it is my obligation to aid in the face of this immense danger. I'll do my best to assist.
Yuanwu: Are you alright, younger mister/miss?
Yuanwu: This is one of the largest TD Outbreaks I've witnessed. There have already been quite a few casualties. It seems far from over yet.
Yuanwu: I still have some supplies with me. Please, take them. Stay safe out there.
(If player talks to Serious Patroller before Taoqi)
Serious Patroller: Hello, Rover. This is our temporary storage site. Help yourself to anything you need.
Serious Patroller: People have generously donated a lot of supplies, and we must not disappoint them. Our mission is to defend this location at all costs.
Serious Patroller: If you have questions, talk to Director Taoqi at the nearby pass. She's in charge.
(If player talks to Yhan before Taoqi)
Yhan: You still up for another fight or two?
Resilient Midnight Ranger: Don't underestimate us, sir! Absolutely!
High-spirited Midnight Ranger: We'll make sure those monsters leave defeated!
Yhan: Good. That's the spirt. Remember what I've taught you!
Yhan: Safety first, then take down as many of them as you can. Understood?
Midnight Ranger: Aye, sir!
Aalto: Any update on the protective barrier?
Taoqi: We've put in all our resources to repair it. But, if those Tacet Discords keep coming at us, it might not hold up for long.
Taoqi: Ah, I presume you must be Rover?
And you are...
Taoqi: Hmm... Maybe we've met somewhere before?
Taoqi: Anyway, please allow me to introduce myself. I am Taoqi, a Director at the Ministry of Development. I'm in charge of our defense fortifications.
Taoqi: Thank you for lending us a hand.
What is this barrier you were talking about?
Taoqi: It's our defense system against the Retroact Rain. It does a good job of keeping the city safe from the rain's effects.
Is the TD Outbreak still going on?
Aalto: What's more, the current TD Outbreak we're dealing with is directly caused by the Retroact Rain.
Taoqi: Once the protective barrier breaks down, Tacet Discords could manifest from inside Jinzhou city...
How does the Retroact Rain cause TD Outbreaks?
Aalto: Rover, remember what I told you earlier?
Aalto: The Retroact Rain is essentially condensed droplets of Remnant Energy that fall from the Etheric Sea.
Aalto: This Remnant Energy makes it a magnet for Tacet Discords.
Aalto: It records events from all times and places, allowing those who come into contact with it to witness illusions of past events.
Aalto: That's what we call the Phantoms of Retroact Rain.
Aalto: It kind of works like how Resonators "Resonate" with the world. The more you're exposed to the rain, the more realistic those Phantoms become.
Aalto: Oh, and here's another interesting fact about Retroact Rain: when it's raining across a large area, illusions pulled from the memoires of multiple people can manifest at once.
The Threnodian of War...
And the deaths during these battles...
Aalto: Nice catch, Rover.
Aalto: Jinzhou has been a battleground for centuries. That's why it has to deal with the Threnodian that represents the concept of war, and wars will lead to deaths.
Aalto: Once the Retroact Rain reaches its final stage, there will be thousands of Phantoms... Phantoms of dead soldiers and Tacet Discords.
Taoqi: This is the one major threat that has been looming over Jinzhou.
Taoqi: Our Magistrate ordered the construction of this barrier precisely because of that.
What's so big about these Phantoms?
Taoqi: Indeed the Phantoms should only mechanically repeat what they had been doing. They shouldn't have the ability to interfere with reality.
Taoqi: But the Retroact Rain can be significantly enhanced through the Threnodian's power.
Taoqi: As a result, said Phantoms become increasingly realistic to the point of inflicting real harm on humans.
Taoqi: In that battle three years ago, our soldiers got into a gruelsome fight against countless Tacet Discords, either native to Norfall Barrens, or produced by the Retroact Rain... and endless swarms of Phantoms.
Taoqi: "Phantoms" of Tacet Discords and our fallen soldiers repeated their indiscriminate attacks on everything in their sight.
Taoqi: Soldiers could not tell friends from foe. The relentless rain even recreated the brutal deaths of their comrades, etched in vivid detail.
Taoqi: The Norfall Barrens turned into a living hell, and to this day, we can still hear the desperate cries...
Aalto: The "Battle Beneath the Crescent" was humanity's first reordered encounter with Retroact Rain enhanced by Threnodian power.
Aalto: Your previous General sent back valuable video recordings of the rain. Those videos provided crucial information, which allowed nations worldwide to speed up their research on defense against the Retroact Rain.
Aalto: Our people at the Black Shores have theorized that the Threnodian, abnormal "moon" sightings, and the Retroact Rain may be linked.
Rain indicates changes in the moon's appearance...
...which in turn reflects the Threnodian's strength.
Aalto: Yeah, something like that. But it's only a theory. We don't have enough data to verify anything.
Aalto: So unfortunately, we can't predict Retroact Rains yet, but we know it's closely connected with Threnodians reviving. The TD Outbreaks are another sign.
Taoqi: The moon just changed in an instant. If this theory turns out true, that means...
The Threnodian is reviving sooner.
Aalto: And Jinzhou's dealing with what happened three years ago.
Couldn't see it coming.
We can get through this.
Aalto: A Threnodian's revival is never an independent occurrence. They can sense one another through some form of telepathic link.
Aalto: The revival of a Threnodian in Jinzhou will trigger catastrophic events and effect other nations.
Aalto: We gotta hustle back to the Tethys base, re-calibrate our Lament Detector, and warn them before it's too late.
Aalto: Anyway, we'll take our leave now.
Encore: Please stay safe...
Taoqi: That's all we've gathered so far, Rover.
Taoqi: The TD Outbreaks won't stop before the end of this rain. We must stay alert.
Staff from Ministry of Development: Ma'am! There's another wave of them ahead!
Taoqi: Sigh. Speak of the devil...
Taoqi: I'll NEED to take a very long nap after this.
Taoqi: Activate the defense mechanisms!
(Cutscene plays) (Cutscene ends)
Taoqi: Everyone, hold your ground!
(After defeating the Tacet Discords)
Taoqi: The Tacet Discords have been delt with. Let's go reinforce the outpost, it's still under attack.
(After helping the soldier surrounded by Tacet Discords)
Rescued Soldier: Thank you! Some of us are still fighting in there. We must go help them!
(After defeating the Tacet Discords in base)
Taoqi: Phew... Finally.
Rescued Soldier: We made it! Thank you so much!
Taoqi: It's dangerous here. Let's head back first.
Chixia: Ugh... Please tell me this is the last one!
Chixia: Rover, your moves are sharp as always. Dealing with so many TDs seems like a walk in the park for you.
Practice makes perfect.
It's all thanks to you.
Can't call it a day without fighting those monsters.
They seemed unusually aggressive.
Yangyang: Rover, did you see that?
The moon looks even more blurry now.
Taoqi: Now it's almost identical to what we saw three years ago, during the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".
Taoqi: I'm afraid... We're already running out of time.
Jinhsi (Contacting): Report the situation, please.
Taoqi: Madam Magistrate, the barrier has been fully repaired and we have evacuated all residents. We've successfully minimized the damage.
Jinhsi (Contacting): Well done, Director Taoqi.
Long time no see.
How's it going on your end?
Is this another pre-recorded message?
Jinhsi (Contacting): Indeed, it's been a while, Rover.
Jinhsi (Contacting): It's been going according to plan, if I may say so. I was made aware of this in advance, and planned out our defense beforehand.
Was it another hint from Jué?
Have you found Jué?
Jinhsi (Contacting): Now that we are facing such an emergency, I cannot sit back and wait for Jué to save us. I will act and see my duty through. This is my decision.
Jinhsi (Contacting): I have secured some much-needed aid for our city during my visit to the capital. Also, our experts should be ready by now.
Jinhsi (Contacting): Rover, do you still remember Jué's message for you?
Jinhsi (Contacting): Now we have raindrops that fall upstream, and the Midnight Rangers' General in the Norfall Barrens, ready to take on the OvathraxThrenodian.
Jinhsi (Contacting): This must be the right time Jué was talking about.
Jinhsi (Contacting): Rover, it's going to be dangerous. You might... directly confront a Threnodian.
I'm ready to go.
Jinhsi (Contacting): Your eyes look as determined as ever.
I have no other choice.
Jinhsi (Contacting): I understand how you must feel, Rover.
Jinhsi (Contacting): I have been in a similar situation before. When my life suddenly took a big turn, and I had no choice but to face it head on.
I'll lend you a hand.
Jinhsi (Contacting): On the entire Jinzhou's behalf, I am immensely grateful for your assistance, Rover.
Jinhsi (Contacting): You will be remembered as a heroic ally in our defense against external threats, regardless of the outcome of this battle.
Jinhsi (Contacting): May victory prevail the lasting night. I will pray for your safe return.
Taoqi: Rover, I have informed border checkpoints across Jinzhou about your trip to the front line. You have been granted unlimited access to all places.
Taoqi: Yangyang, you're one of our Outriders. I hope you can go with Rover and provide assistance.
Taoqi: You'll need to pass through a Tacet Field to reach our base in the Desorock Highland. Please be careful.
Chixia: Rover, Yangyang, I'll be keepin' the city safe as a Patroller. Do come back in one piece, okay?
You can do it, Chixia!
Chixia: Thanks! I'll give it my all!
You can do it, Ma Xiaofang!
Chixia: Rover! I said don't call me that... Nevermind we don't have time for this.
You can do it, Jinzhou Speedster!
Chixia: Wow, thanks Rover! Can't believe you still remember that title! I'll live up to it for sure!
Taoqi: It seems the rain is not stopping anytime soon...
Yangyang: The city... What if...
Chixia: Rest assured. You can count on me!
Yaunwu: I will keep everyone safe.
Verina: Me... Me too!
Lingyang: Don't forget us Liondance Troupe!
Soldiers: We've got this!
Taoqi: Hehe, as you can see. Everyone's ready to defend our city.
Chixia: Rover, Yangyang, safe travels!
Taoqi: I've informed General Jiyan that you're heading to his place. He will be meeting up with you soon.
Chixia: May victory prevail the lasting night!

Meanwhile, in the Desorock Highland...

Jiyan: Defend the south gate! Enemy attack weakening. This wave is almost over!
Fighting Soldiers: North gate! Monsters incoming!
Jiyan: Our enemies are spent. Hold your ground!
Fighting Soldiers: It's over!
Jiyan: All Tacet Discords nearby have been dealt with. Now, the city's defense...
Jiyan: Please update me on the situation in Jinzhou city.
Taoqi (Contacting): Under Madam Magistrate's command, the barrier has been activated and citizens are being evacuated to the safe zone.
Taoqi (Contacting): Huaxu Academy and Ministry of Development are on standby for further instructions. Bazhi is overseeing operations at the Academy while Mortefi has arrived at the Ministry. Rest assured, we are all safe in the city.
Taoqi (Contacting): And that Rover... He/She is heading over to meet you. Yangyang is coming with him/her.
Jiyan: I see. We have successfully contained the Outbreak here at the base.
Jiyan: I will go pick them up as soon as possible.
Jiyan: The rain's getting heavier...
Jiyan: There are signs of Tacet Discords reviving. Intense frequency fluctuations detected.... they'll be passing through that area. I must create a safe passage for them.
Jiyan: I need to clear the way for them as quickly as possible.
Jiyan: A couple more Tacet Discords here... Time to get rid of them.
Jiyan: Is that...
Jiyan: The Thundering Mephis?

On the other side of the Desorock Highland...

Yangyang: The Threnodian's revival has done significant damage to the environment nearby...
Yangyang: Things have gotten even more dangerous out here. The closer we get to Norfall Barrens, the worse it gets.
Yangyang: The Streams feel heavy with dread and the smell of blood... There must be a brutal fight going down in the Desorock Highland.
Yangyang: The Tacet Field Director Taoqi mentioned should be right up ahead. We must pass through it to reach our base and find General Jiyan.
Yangyang: I wonder what other anomalies await us ahead...
(Approach the three phantom soldiers)
Yangyang: Is that one of our soldiers ahead?
